description: This file is the main React component for a Tic-Tac-Toe game frontend. It includes game logic for determining the winner, manages game state, and renders the game UI components such as Board, Scoreboard, and Controls.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Calculates the winner of the current Tic-Tac-Toe board based on predefined winning lines. Returns an object with the winner ('X' or 'O') and the winning line, or null if no winner.

methods.name: handleSquareClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on a game square, updates game state, and updates scores if a win or draw occurs.

methods.name: handleResetBoard
methods.description: Resets the game board to the initial empty state and sets the first player to 'X'.

methods.name: handleNewMatch
methods.description: Resets the game board and scores to start a new match.
